page.layout: One blank page of stained paper with no printed text; only mottling, edge shadows and a few specks of dirt.
page.notes: The scan shows a blank leaf (apparently a pastedown or endpaper) with no printed words, no page number, no running head and no signature. Only stains, foxing, a dark edge at the left and a few ink specks at the right edge are visible; none of these is printed text, so nothing is transcribed.
